name: PLC directory (plc.directory) as operated by Bluesky Social PBC
jurisdiction_note: Bluesky Social PBC is a US public benefit corporation and still operates plc.directory. The PLC Org says it must still 'get ready to take over the PLC directory assets and operations' (transfer NOT complete as of 2026-09-28).

name: Public Ledger of Credentials Organization (Swiss Association)
jurisdiction_note: Registered Swiss Association announced Sept 2025 and formally established by 2026-09-28. It does not yet operate the directory. Its board includes a Bluesky engineer (Bryan Newbold), and funding is a bootstrap payment from Bluesky.

name: Bluesky Social PBC AppView / Bluesky app
jurisdiction_note: US public benefit corporation. The AppView computes verification validity and hosts the trusted-verifier policy.

name: Bluesky Social PBC PDS hosting (bsky.social / *.bsky.network)
jurisdiction_note: US company. By default it holds users' repo signing key and did:plc rotation keys, and it controls the *.bsky.social handle namespace.

name: DNS registrar / authoritative DNS host for the handle domain
jurisdiction_note: Varies by registrar and TLD.

name: Web host for the user's domain (.well-known files)
jurisdiction_note: Varies by the host the user picks.

name: Bluesky Trusted Verifier organizations (e.g. NYT, FT, The Athletic)
jurisdiction_note: Multiple organizations in various jurisdictions (many US media orgs), approved by Bluesky.

name: Keybase (Zoom Video Communications)
jurisdiction_note: Acquired by Zoom Video Communications (San Jose, CA, USA) in May 2020.

name: Stellar public network (Keybase Merkle root memos)
jurisdiction_note: Public blockchain; Keybase posts hourly root hashes from account GA72...SV6E.

name: GitHub
jurisdiction_note: Microsoft subsidiary, USA.

name: X (Twitter)
jurisdiction_note: X Corp., USA.

name: Reddit
jurisdiction_note: Reddit, Inc., USA.

name: Hacker News (Y Combinator)
jurisdiction_note: Y Combinator, USA.

name: Mastodon instances
jurisdiction_note: Each instance is run by a different operator in different countries.

name: keys.openpgp.org
jurisdiction_note: Volunteer community effort (Sequoia-PGP, OpenKeychain, Enigmail contributors); hosting sponsored by Hetzner Online GmbH, Germany.

name: Keyoxide ASPE server (keyoxide.org)
jurisdiction_note: Operated by the Keyoxide project (NLnet-funded); legal entity and country not stated in sources found.

name: Email provider
jurisdiction_note: Depends on provider.

name: Sigstore Fulcio public-good CA (OpenSSF, on GCP)
jurisdiction_note: Run by the OpenSSF (Linux Foundation, US) with volunteer engineers from Chainguard, GitHub, Google, Red Hat, Stacklok; hosted on Google Cloud, CA keys in GCP KMS/Certificate Authority Service.

name: Sigstore Rekor public-good transparency log (OpenSSF, on GCP)
jurisdiction_note: Same OpenSSF operations SIG; Rekor v1 remains default as of 2026-06, Rekor v2 shards (logYEAR-rev.rekor.sigstore.dev) run in parallel.

name: Google (OIDC)
jurisdiction_note: Google LLC, US; OIDC IdP for Sigstore and OAuth provider for Passport.

name: Microsoft (OIDC)
jurisdiction_note: Microsoft Corp., US; email OIDC IdP accepted by public-good Fulcio via Dex.

name: Human Passport (Holonym Foundation / human.tech)
jurisdiction_note: Privacy policy lists Holonym Foundation, Wilmington, DE, United States; acquisition of Gitcoin Passport completed Dec 2024.

name: OP Mainnet (and other EVM chains hosting EAS stamps)
jurisdiction_note: Single sequencer operated by OP Labs PBC (US); shared sequencing planned but not live in 2026.

name: WebPKI TLS certificate authority
jurisdiction_note: Whichever CA issued the domain's TLS cert; did:web requires the DID to match the TLS cert name.

name: Nostr relays (independent operators)
jurisdiction_note: Many independently run relays in many countries. Clients publish to several. The PR #2486 survey used 11 major relays.

name: Telegram
jurisdiction_note: Operational center in Dubai, UAE; registered in the British Virgin Islands.

name: Discord Inc.
jurisdiction_note: San Francisco, CA.

name: Snapchain validators (replaced Farcaster Hubs in 2025)
jurisdiction_note: Multiple validators, reported as 11 and community-voted (secondary source). Since January 2026 Neynar operates protocol infrastructure, and validator config is managed on-chain via SnapchainConfigRegistry (snapchain v0.14.2).

name: Farcaster app (formerly Warpcast), owned by Neynar since 2026-01
jurisdiction_note: Merkle Manufactory (US) built it, and Neynar (US) acquired it in January 2026 per CoinDesk.

name: BitTorrent Mainline DHT
jurisdiction_note: Open P2P network of about 10M nodes worldwide with no operator.

name: Pkarr HTTP relays (pkarr.pubky.app, pkarr.pubky.org, relay.pkarr.org)
jurisdiction_note: Default relays listed in the repo, mostly run by Synonym/Pubky. I did not confirm the operator's country. Relays are optional.

name: Storacha Network (formerly web3.storage / DAG House, Protocol Labs spin-out)
jurisdiction_note: ToS governed by Delaware law (web3.storage/docs/terms); entity not confirmed. Writes disabled 2026-05-15; hosts decommissioned by 2026-09-05.

name: Postmark (transactional email sender used by web3.storage/Storacha for confirmation links)
jurisdiction_note: Postmark is operated by ActiveCampaign (US); its use comes from a 2023 web3.storage planning note, so current use is unverified.

name: Ethereum chain (for ERC-1271 contract-wallet verification)
jurisdiction_note: Public permissionless chain; only consulted for contract wallets.
